[*][b]Anti-fan raid[/b]: disgruntled viewers might organize a hate raid against your colony![/*]
[*][b]Keyword-triggered gifts[/b]: viewers send different items based on a keyword table, adding more depth to live interaction.[/*]
[/list]Viewer Ecosystem
[list]
[*][b]Viewer pool system[/b]: regular viewers have unique nicknames, IDs, personalities, and chat frequencies (Rare/Normal/Active/Chatterbox). Full custom add, import, and export support.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic viewer count[/b]: online numbers fluctuate with in-game events—major incidents draw crowds, peaceful periods see a drop.[/*]
[*][b]Popularity system[/b]: stream popularity influences gift and purchase probabilities. The more exciting the event, the higher the heat.[/*]
[*][b]Nickname filter[/b]: automatically filters sensitive and prohibited words.[/*]
[/list]UI & Experience
[list]
[*][b]Stream title[/b]: editable stream title with optional auto-randomization. Sensitive words are auto-filtered to *.[/*]
[*][b]Danmaku window[/b]: fully customizable—drag to reposition, resize, adjust opacity, and use compact mode.[/*]
[*][b]Toggle button[/b]: a handy toggle in the bottom-right corner to show or hide the danmaku window instantly.[/*]
[/list]Mod Compatibility
[list]
[*][b]Phinix[/b]: automatically uses your Phinix player name as the streamer name, and reads other players’ nicknames from the chat room to use as viewer names.[/*]
[*][b]RimTalk[/b]: memory extension integration injects common-sense knowledge for richer danmaku context.[/*]
[*][b]RimChat[/b]: faction fan club tie-ins and social circle dynamics.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Quick Start[/heading]
Enable the mod and a danmaku window plus a toggle button will appear automatically.
Click the danmaku window’s title to edit the stream title.
Use the bottom input box to send your own danmaku and interact with viewers; during votes, type 1-4 to participate.

nodes.name: Epoch World Host

nodes.description:
Epoch World Host
[heading]English[/heading]
What is Epoch?
Epoch World Host is an experimental RimWorld mod that explores a different way of observing simulated worlds.
Instead of treating the game as a collection of independent objects, Epoch observes it as a network of evolving processes.
The current version does [b]not[/b] replace the storyteller and does [b]not[/b] attempt to control the colony.
Instead, Epoch watches the world alongside the storyteller.
It observes.
It remembers.
It searches for motives behind events.
Pressure, entropy and recovery are treated as properties of the world itself rather than isolated gameplay values.
This project is an experiment.
The goal is not to make RimWorld easier or harder.
The goal is to explore whether a simulated world can be observed as a living system.
[line]
Current Features
[list]
[*]World observation panel[/*]
[*]Storyteller context[/*]
[*]Pressure / Entropy / Recovery metrics[/*]
[*]World motive display[/*]
[*]Intervention history[/*]
[*]Experimental architecture for future development[/*]
[/list][line]
Current State
This is an early experimental release.
Many ideas are still evolving, and both the implementation and user interface may change significantly over time.
Feedback, criticism and discussion are welcome.
[line]
Русский
[heading]Что такое Epoch?[/heading]
Epoch World Host — экспериментальный мод для RimWorld, исследующий другой способ наблюдения за симулируемыми мирами.
Вместо того чтобы рассматривать игру как набор отдельных объектов, Epoch воспринимает её как сеть непрерывно развивающихся процессов.
Текущая версия [b]не заменяет[/b] рассказчика и [b]не управляет[/b] колонией.
Epoch существует рядом с рассказчиком.
Он наблюдает.
Запоминает.
Пытается понять мотивы происходящего.
Давление, энтропия и восстановление рассматриваются не как отдельные игровые параметры, а как свойства состояния мира.
Этот проект является экспериментом.
Его цель — не упростить игру и не усложнить её.
Цель проекта — исследовать возможность наблюдения за игровым миром как за живой системой.
[line]

[list]
[*]панель наблюдения Epoch;[/*]

[*]журнал вмешательств;[/*]
[*]экспериментальная архитектура для дальнейшего развития.[/*]
[/list][line]
Текущее состояние
Это ранняя экспериментальная версия.
Многие идеи ещё находятся в процессе развития, поэтому архитектура, интерфейс и механики могут существенно измениться.
Буду рад любым отзывам, предложениям и обсуждениям.

nodes.name: RimLogic
nodes.summary: RimLogic — electro-logic blocks for colony automation.
nodes.description:
[b][size=4]RimLogic[/size][/b]
[b]Electro-logic blocks for players who like their base to think for itself[/b]

[b]Overview[/b]
RimLogic adds a system of electro-logic blocks for automating your RimWorld colony. It is made for those moments when simply flipping switches by hand is not enough, and you want to build an actual readable circuit: a sensor detects something, logic checks the condition, and the right block turns power on, changes state, shows a number, or sends a notification.

The mod includes signal links between blocks, normal interaction with the power grid, sensors, logic blocks, timers, memory, generators, screens, an alert speaker, and several functional utility blocks. Signal links can be shown directly on the map: colored lines make it clear which blocks are connected and where the signal is going. That becomes especially useful once a circuit grows beyond just two or three blocks.

With the diode, you can make power flow in only one direction. No more strange chains of switches when all you really need is a simple one-way power path. The diode makes those setups cleaner and easier to understand.

Every block has its own settings menu.

[b]Blocks and what they do[/b]

[b]Sensors[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Light sensor[/b] — reacts to the current light level.[/*]
[*][b]Motion sensor[/b] — detects selected creature types in an area: colonists, animals, enemies, prisoners, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Temperature sensor[/b] — checks temperature against a chosen condition.[/*]
[*][b]Power sensor[/b] — monitors free energy in the grid or stored battery charge.[/*]
[*][b]Pollution sensor[/b] — reacts to pollution in an area.[/*]
[*][b]Fire sensor[/b] — triggers when there is fire nearby.[/*]
[/list][b]Logic blocks[/b]
[list]
[*][b]AND[/b] — outputs a signal when all inputs are active.[/*]
[*][b]OR[/b] — outputs a signal when at least one input is active.[/*]
[*][b]XOR[/b] — outputs a signal when exactly one input is active.[/*]
[*][b]NAND[/b] — inverted AND.[/*]
[*][b]NOR[/b] — inverted OR.[/*]
[*][b]XNOR[/b] — inverted XOR.[/*]
[*][b]Splitter[/b] — copies one signal to several outputs.[/*]
[/list][b]Functional blocks[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Switch[/b] — a switch controlled by signals.[/*]
[*][b]Selector[/b] — switches power between two outputs.[/*]
[*][b]Math block[/b] — performs math operations and comparisons on numeric values.[/*]
[*][b]Multitool[/b] — a general-purpose block with several modes: counting items, pawns or harvest-ready crops, controlling doors and devices, and checking storage fullness.[/*]
[/list][b]Generators, memory and output[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Diode[/b] — lets power pass in one direction only.[/*]
[*][b]Signal generator[/b] — a constant signal source.[/*]
[*][b]Tick generator[/b] — a periodic pulse.[/*]
[*][b]Register[/b] — changes state when it receives a signal.[/*]
[*][b]Timer[/b] — delays a signal.[/*]
[*][b]Memory[/b] — stores a numeric value.[/*]
[*][b]Screen[/b] — displays a digit; several screens can be used together to show a number.[/*]
[*][b]Clock[/b] — outputs a signal at a chosen time of day.[/*]
[*][b]Speaker[/b] — sends a custom notification on any signal.[/*]
[/list][b]Documentation and compatibility[/b]
Documentation is still in progress. It will be added on [url=https://github.com/klimprog/RimLogic]GitHub [/url]later:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3750951495]Steam Workshop[/url]

nodes.name: Carnivore Milk Plant
nodes.summary: Carnivorous plant that consumes corpses and converts them into milk.
nodes.description:
Too many corpses piling up around your colony? No time to bury them, and butchering just adds more work and mood penalties you don’t need? Good news. A researcher, allegedly inspired by simulations from “The Simulator 2” has reproduced a self-sustaining carnivorous plant. It consumes fresh corpses automatically, converting them into internal nutrients that are gradually processed into milk-like fluid.

[b]How to install :[/b]
[list]
[*]Download this mod.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip file[/*]
[*]Move the extracted folder to your RimWorld "Mods" directory.[/*]
[*]Open RimWorld, go to the mod manager, and enable the "Carnivore Milk Plant" mod.[/*]
[*]Don’t forget to save your mod configuration[/*]
[/list][b]How to Use[/b]
[list]
[*]Build the [b]"Carnivore Milk Plant"[/b] from the Production section. (it requires : 10 gold,10 silver,10 wood)[/*]
[*]Place fresh corpses nearby; the plant will handle the rest automatically.[/*]
[/list][b]How It Works:[/b]
[left][list]
[*]The plant consumes nearby corpses when “hungry.”[/*]
[*]Corpses are processed using standard butchering mechanics, avoiding mood debuffs.[/*]
[*]Items on the corpse are separated and dropped.[/*]
[*]Meat is stored internally and gradually converted into milk.[/*]
[*]The plant does not die when empty; it pauses production until new corpses are available. [/*]
[*][b]Note:[/b] Leather is consumed, and not converted into nutrition.[/*]
[/list][/left]
[b]F.A.Q. (Frequently Avoided Questions)[/b]

Q: Why not use the same name or mechanics as “The Simulator 2”?
A: Copyright.

Q: Why not use the same mechanics as "Harbinger tree"?
A: I don't know where the source code is, and I like the Carnivore Milk Plant from  “The Simulator 2”

Q: What happens if I place rotten corpses, downed pawn, raw meat, stone, or other items?
A: Nothing happens. The plant only accepts valid fresh corpses. Everything else is ignored according to its internal processing standards.

Q: What if I want the leather?
A: Simply butcher the corpse manually at a butchering workbench.

Q: Will this milk reverse aging like in “The Simulator 2”?
A: No, even with glterworld Biotechnology, we cannot reverse the aging

Q: I don’t like the default parameters : it’s too fast, too slow, too wasteful, or too efficient. How can I change them?
A: According to classified reports, a few clever “hackers” have infiltrated the game files and discovered a hidden vault located in
[code]RimWorld\Mods\Carnivore Milk Plant\Defs\ThingDefs\CarnivoreMilkPlant.xml[/code]They managed to modify values such as :
[code]<radius>2</radius>
<digestTime>10</digestTime>
<maxBuffer>100</maxBuffer>
<efficiency>0.75</efficiency>[/code]at will. We are still investigating how such unauthorized access to “fictional configuration files” is even possible.
